_comentario: MODELO TEENS. Aula 15 = FALA (aula impar) no formato CONVERSA (atualizacao 01/10/2026 do CURRICULO): verbos de percepcao + objeto (see / hear / watch somebody do x doing). Era a aula 09 do desenho original; volta depois do checkpoint de PP, na ordem do curriculo. Tema bloco G (fazer e vender); fato dono: as pulseiras que ela vendeu na feira da escola. Video em aula (YouTube nocookie, Masha Knots). Visual juvenil inline. Vozes iguais as aulas 1-14.

lesson.grammar_point: verbs of perception + object: see / hear / watch somebody do vs doing

listenings.text: Sophia, it's Ruby! I'm at the fair, at our stall, and you won't believe it. Ten minutes ago, I saw a teacher stop, look at every bracelet, and buy three! Right now I can hear people laughing at the next stall, and I can see a little boy browsing our table. He has touched every pattern. Oh, and I watched a girl try on the pink one. She loved it! Please come quickly. We need more beads!
